answers.workaround:
I think it can be worked around by iterating through get_property_list() and copying all the properties.

This covers my basic needs, but is likely incomplete and doesn't have an option for deep copy.

```gdscript
## Just duplicates a class object properties for now.  May need to be expanded to inclued meta and other data later.
static func duplicate_object(source_object : Object, destination_object : Object) -> Object:
	var properties := source_object.get_property_list()
	for property in properties:
		var property_name : StringName = property[&"name"]
		if (property_name != &"RefCounted" && property_name != &"Built-in script"):
			destination_object[property_name] = source_object[property_name]
	return destination_object
````
